About us

Independent software research for the public benefit

ASSERT Research is a Swedish non-profit association that conducts and promotes scientific research and development in software technology.

Who we are

ASSERT Research

ASSERT Research (ideell förening) is a public-benefit association. We pursue our mission openly, impartially, and with scientific independence.

This website and the assert-research.org domain are owned and operated by ASSERT Research.

Our purpose

Research that remains accessible

  • Conduct and promote scientific research and development in software technology and adjacent fields.
  • Apply for, manage, and administer grants for research and educational initiatives.
  • Make research results accessible to the public, industry, and the scientific community.
  • Collaborate with universities, public bodies, industry, and other organizations.
